run_generate_cli_reference: run the generate_cli_reference function to produce markdown CLI docs from the hf Typer CLI
update_cli_reference: update the CLI reference markdown file by running the script with --update flag
check_cli_reference: check the CLI reference file for content mismatches against the generated output
normalize_command_aliases: normalize pipe-separated command aliases in generated Typer documentation into clean format
strip_hidden_commands: strip deprecated or hidden commands from the generated CLI reference content
